description: Training parameters passed to slurm_train.sh. The keys are the allow list of the PASK VAMS poller.
inputInstructions: Select the whole asset that holds a LeRobot dataset at its root (meta/info.json at the asset root), or a curation view (curation_manifest.json with mode view at the asset root), as the input, and another asset as the output. The checkpoint (checkpoints/last/pretrained_model) is written to the output asset, and the training summary is recorded as results/pask_training.json.

tagSchema.label: Policy type
tagSchema.description: Policy to train. pi05 needs the q01/q99 quantiles in meta/stats.json.

tagSchema.label: Pretrained model
tagSchema.description: Hugging Face Hub ID of the base model. Use lerobot/pi0_base with POLICY_TYPE pi0.

tagSchema.label: Fine-tuning mode
tagSchema.description: lora trains LoRA adapters, expert_only trains the action expert, full trains every parameter.

tagSchema.label: LoRA rank
tagSchema.description: Rank of the LoRA adapters. Used only with FINETUNE_MODE lora.

tagSchema.label: LoRA alpha
tagSchema.description: Scaling factor of the LoRA adapters. Used only with FINETUNE_MODE lora.

tagSchema.label: Checkpoint interval
tagSchema.description: Steps between checkpoints. Each checkpoint takes FSx space until the run is cleaned up.

tagSchema.label: Log interval
tagSchema.description: Steps between training log lines and MLflow metrics.

tagSchema.label: Data loader workers
tagSchema.description: Number of data loader worker processes. Must be 1 or more.

tagSchema.label: Container image tag
tagSchema.description: Tag of the lerobot-pi-train enroot image built on the cluster.
